value.rationale: This gives a complete explicit design rule and a proof over an infinite, naturally occurring family of 4-regular graphs. It finds three alternating spectral contacts, proves strictly positive holding and both jump types without imposing them, and quantifies the counterintuitive phenomenon that a probability vanishing as n^{-2} quadruples the optimal asymptotic spectral gap versus the distance-two cycle. This is stronger than a small finite table or routine normalization calculation.
